
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(questionr)

F4_F2 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_F4_F2_pour_long.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

# Pivot longer
```{r}

vars_num <- F4_F2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>%
  select(-where(is.character)) %>% 
  colnames()

F4_F3 <- F4_F2 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(vars_num),
      .fns = ~ if_else(.x == -7, NA_integer_, .x)
    )
  )

vars_to_pivot <- F4_F3 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie0_long <- F4_F3 %>%  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_to_pivot),
    names_to = c("rang_frt", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "fa_frt(.\\d+)_(\\w+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )


```

# Renommer variables

```{r}

vars_module <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  select(prenom:deces_an) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie1_long <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  rename_with( ~ paste0("fa_frt_", .x), all_of(vars_module)) %>% 
  rename("fa_fr_rang" = "rang_frt")

rm(list = c("vars_module", "vars_num", "vars_to_pivot"))

```

# Introduire tagged_na

```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_tagged_na.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_levels_na.R")
library(labelled)

vars_rcd <- fratrie1_long %>% 
  select(where(is.double)) %>% 
  select(-fa_fr_date_creation) %>% 
  colnames()

# Les deux fonctions fonctionnent!

fratrie2_long <- fratrie1_long %>%
  rcd_tagged_na(all_of(vars_rcd)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_rcd), lbl_levels_na))

table(as_factor(fratrie2_long$fa_frt_deces_an), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("vars_rcd", "lbl_levels_na", "rcd_tagged_na"))

```

# Ajouter value labels

```{r}
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_mois.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_oui_non.R")

all_mois <- fratrie2_long %>% 
  select(contains("mois")) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_bin <- fratrie2_long %>% 
    select(fa_frt_diag_avt_nais, fa_frt_muco, fa_frt_decede) %>% 
    colnames()

fratrie3_long <- fratrie2_long %>% 
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_mois), rcd_mois),
    across(all_of(vars_bin), lbl_oui_non)
  ) %>%
    add_value_labels(
        fa_frt_sexe = c(
            "Male" = 1,
            "Female" = 2
        ),
        fa_frt_issu = c(
            "Full sibling" = 1,
            "Half-sibling" = 2,
            "Adopted sibling" = 3
        )
    )

table(as_factor(fratrie3_long$fa_frt_deces_mois), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("rcd_mois", "lbl_oui_non", "all_mois", "vars_bin"))
```

## Verifier qu'il ne reste plus de neg

```{r verif rcd}

verif_ch <- fratrie3_long %>%
  filter(if_any(where(is.character), ~ grepl("^-\\d", .)))

verif_db <- fratrie3_long %>% 
  filter(if_any(where(is.numeric), ~ . < 0))

rm(list = c("verif_ch", "verif_db"))

```

# META DATA


```{r}
fratrie_L <- haven::read_dta("/Users/alicethomassin/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/Peter/thoa4_4Siblings_L573.dta")

dico_fr <- generate_dictionary(fratrie_L) %>% 
  convert_list_columns_to_character() %>% 
  select(variable, label, col_type, value_labels) %>% 
  mutate(
    origin = if_else(str_detect(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+ "), "question", "derived"),
    ref = if_else(
      (col_type == "chr" & origin == "question" & !str_detect(variable, "(_nom)|(_prenom)")), 
      paste0(str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"), "_txt"), 
      str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"))
  ) %>% 
    relocate(ref, .after = variable) %>% 
    group_by(ref) %>% 
    mutate(
      n_obs = n(),
      ref = replace_when(
        ref,
        str_detect(label, "(MR)") ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number()),
        !is.na(ref) & n_obs > 1 & col_type != "chr" ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number())
      )
    ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      mutate(
        order = row_number()
      ) %>% 
        relocate(order) %>% 
        select(-n_obs)

```

```{r}
siblings <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/meta_questions/siblings.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

meta_fr <- siblings %>% 
  mutate(
    ref = str_replace_all(variable, "-", "0"),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "_(?!txt$)[[:alpha:]]+$", ""),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "0(?=\\d{2,})", ""),
    .before = variable
  ) %>% 
    group_by(ref) %>% 
    mutate(
      n_obs = n(),
      ref = if_else(n_obs > 1, paste0(ref, "_", row_number()), ref)
    ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
    select(-variable, -n_obs) %>% 
  right_join(
    dico_fr %>% select(order, variable, ref),
    by = "ref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>% 
    relocate(variable) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(variable)) %>% 
    mutate(
      notes_fr = NA_character_,
      notes_en = NA_character_,
      skip_pattern_en = skip_pattern,
      skip_pattern_fr = NA_character_,
      filter_fr = NA_character_,
      filter_en = NA_character_,
      source_fr = NA_character_,
      source_en = NA_character_
    ) %>% 
      relocate(order) %>% 
      arrange(order) %>% 
      select(-order) %>% 
      relocate(c("skip_pattern_fr", "skip_pattern_en"), .after = question_en) %>%
      relocate(c("filter_fr", "filter_en"), .after = skip_pattern_en) %>%
      relocate(c("source_fr", "source_en"), .after = filter_en) %>% 
      select(-skip_pattern, -source)
```
